name: Anam Tbung
summary: A Jrai rice-flour dish for funerals, weddings, death anniversaries, and a new house. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism cooks it with pork offal, beef offal, or meat.
origin: Siu Phĩu’s account on the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism site separates Anam Tbung from everyday cassava-leaf soup. It is rice flour, usually with offal or meat, and it is not a weekday bowl.
howToEat: Cook it from rice flour with pork offal, beef offal, or meat. A fuller method is Check on arrival.
Eat it at a funeral, a wedding, a death anniversary, or a new house.
where: Jrai kitchens. The speaker in the article is in buôn Ama Hyai, Krông Pa. An hour is Check on arrival.
